# dsh-sticky-notes

A sticky-note wall inside DSH: one icon in the left sidebar, one panel to capture
ideas anytime, and

a file on disk so nothing is lost when the page reloads or the
Harness restarts.
## Install

The bundle is self-contained: no dependencies, no build step, no configuration
required. It targets

a DSH build that ships the `sidebar.panellist` slot
(`engines.dsh: ^0.2.1-alpha.2`).
From a terminal:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Or from the GUI: open DSH → **Plugins / 插件** → **Add / 添加**, and paste the same
address. To install
from a local checkout instead (edits apply on reload):
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Keep the bundle enabled and **refresh the page once** (or restart DSH if the
plugin manager asks for

a restart). A sticky-note icon appears in the left rail;
click it to open the wall.

The wall lives on disk; see **Storage** for the paths, backups and export. A
Chinese install guide s
hips as `INSTALL.md`.
## What it does

- **Sidebar entry** — a panel icon in the left rail; clicking it opens the wall.
- **Quick capture**

— type in the box at the top and press `↵` to add a note
(`⇧↵` for a new line). `⌘/Ctrl + ↵` also a

dds.
- **Images in the input** — paste a screenshot (`⌘V`/`Ctrl+V`), drag an image
anywhere onto the

wall, or pick files with the attach button. A note can carry
up to 6 PNG/JPG/GIF/WebP images (≤8 MB

each), shows thumbnails on the paper, and
opens a full-size preview when a thumbnail is clicked (`E

sc` closes).
- **Six paper colors**, a slight paper tilt, and a masonry wall.
- **Edit in place** —

click a note's text, change it, click away (or `⌘/Ctrl + ↵`)
to save; `Esc` cancels.
- **Pin** a not

e to the top, **delete** it with a 6-second **undo** toast.
- **Search** filters the wall; the foote

r shows saving state.
- **本地备份 / export / import** — the wall is copied to disk before every
overwri

te (last 30 kept), restorable from the header, and exportable or
importable as a JSON file.
- Texts
follow the active DSH locale (Chinese/English).
## Agent tool: `sticky_notes_add`

The Host half also registers a model-facing tool, so a Session can put a note on
the wall without a

browser — including a Session started by an IM bot (Feishu,
WeChat, …), where the human just says “把

ncluding a Session started by an IM bot (Feishu,
WeChat, …), where the human just says “把这张图存到便利贴里”.
| Argument | Meaning |

| `text` | note text; optional when images are given |
| `color` | `amber` (default), `rose`, `sky`,

`mint`, `lilac`, `tangerine` |
| `pinned` | pin the note to the top (default `false`) |
| `imagePat
hs` | image file paths: absolute, or relative to the calling Session's working directory (max 6) |

It reads the bytes itself and enforces the same rules as the panel (PNG/JPG/GIF/
WebP, ≤8 MB each, a

t most 6 images per note), appends one note to the same
`notes.json`, takes the same pre-overwrite b

ackup, and returns
`{ noteId, noteCount, images }`.

The model does **not** need to see the picture: an IM bot stages a received image
into the workspace

and hands the model a path, so even a text-only model can save
a screenshot it never “saw”.

The tool is registered when the plugin loads, so a linked development install
needs the plugin row t

o reload (disable then enable, or restart DSH) before a
Session can call it.
## Zero-token IM command: `/sticky` (optional patch)

An IM message still costs a model turn — even when it only says “save this to a
sticky note”. `scrip

ts/patch-dsh-im-sticky.mjs` patches the installed
`@xmanrui/dsh-im` bundle so a message that starts

with `/sticky` is answered
without a Session turn: it writes the text and any staged images straight

into
the wall and replies with the note id.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then disable and re-enable the “IM机器人” plugin (or restart DSH) and send
`/sticky 测试测试小肥鱼` in Feishu,

with an image attached if you want one saved
too. `/sticky` is not in the plugin’s command panel or

ched if you want one saved
too. `/sticky` is not in the plugin’s command panel or `/help` — type it.
Notes:

- The patch edits a third-party plugin in place. **A dsh-im upgrade overwrites
it** — re-run the scr

ipt afterwards (it verifies its anchors and refuses to
guess on an unknown bundle version).
- The pa

tched path skips the bot’s command-permission check, so keep the bot’s
allowlist tight.
- The wall i

s a single JSON file with last-write-wins writes: an open sticky
panel that saves a stale wall can o

verwrite a note saved from IM. Reload the
panel after an IM save if you keep it open.
## Feishu 多维表格 mirror (optional)

Everything is local-first; the wall can additionally push each note to a Feishu
Bitable (多维表格) table

. It is **one-way and additive**: local files remain the
source of truth, editing or deleting a note

locally does not change its row, and
Feishu being unreachable never blocks a local save (failures a

re logged and
retried on the next tick).
Setup:

1. The Feishu app needs `bitable:app` (or `base:app:create`) and `drive:drive`.
Open the authorizati

on link the setup script prints, have an admin approve it
and publish a version.
2. Run the setup sc

ript — it reuses the bot’s app credentials from DSH, creates
“DSH 便利贴” with the fields `文字 / 颜色 / 置顶

/ 创建时间 / 图片`, and writes
`$DSH_HOME/state/sticky-notes/feishu.json`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

3. Reload the sticky-notes plugin (or restart DSH). New notes are mirrored
within a second or two; t
he wall is also polled every 30 s as a fallback.
How it works:

- `feishu.json` (in the data dir) holds `enabled`, `appId`, `secretRef`,
`appToken`, `tableId`, `bas

eUrl` and `backfillNotes`. Delete it or set
`enabled: false` to stop mirroring.
- `feishu-sync.json`

remembers which note ids were pushed, so a restart never
duplicates rows. Pointing at a different B

itable resets that history.
- With `backfillNotes: true` (the setup default) the existing wall is pu

shed
once; set it to `false` to start from the next new note only.
- Each image is uploaded as a Bit

able attachment (`drive/v1/medias/upload_all`,
`parent_type=bitable_image`); a failed image upload s

till pushes the row
without that image.
